subject: prd/abandoned-feature-retirement
statement: When authority identifies mutable source or code, the system shall bind the exact current generation so removal and later restoration create identities that old authority cannot cover, including a code unit that disappears and returns inside a persistent file.
rationale: Matching bytes alone cannot distinguish restored work.
fit_criterion: Real-Git add, edit, rename, copy, delete/re-add, root, merge-add, multi-file, and same-file unit restoration fixtures agree across every verifier; second deletion refuses old authority.
